summary: The 1:1 agent_templates <-> assistant-user PRINCIPAL link (cinatra#1037 P1.3). Adds agent_templates.assistant_user_id: the bare text id of the Better Auth public."user" assistant principal a conversational (agent_kind='assistant') template is registered AS — the seam the generalized assistant-MCP surface (P5.5) was built handle-generic against (resolveTemplateLinkedAssistantConfig maps a principal id to its persisted sidecar through this column). Bare text (no cross-schema FK, like assistant_threads.assistant_user_id / assistant_handles.assistant_user_id); a PARTIAL UNIQUE index over the non-null values enforces the 1:1 (a principal links to at most one template; executor rows stay NULL and are excluded by the predicate). Gate class DESTRUCTIVE though operationally safe: the schema-migration gate classifies the CREATE UNIQUE INDEX on an existing table (agent_templates) as [unique-index-existing-table] — a unique index can fail on existing duplicates. Here it cannot: assistant_user_id is a brand-new column added in the same change, so every existing row is executor/NULL and the partial predicate (WHERE assistant_user_id IS NOT NULL) matches ZERO existing rows — the index builds with no possible collision. No backfill, no NOT NULL on existing rows, no tightened constraint, no rewrite; the built-in Cinatra principal is linked at boot by the assistant-agent registration bootstrap (ensureBuiltInCinatraAssistantAgent, runs AFTER migrations — identity minted at boot, never by a migration, mirroring the @cinatra seed + handle backfill). Mirrors the idempotent bootstrap DDL in src/lib/drizzle-store.ts (ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS + CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ... WHERE assistant_user_id IS NOT NULL) so fresh-bootstrap and operator-upgrade stay aligned (core__0046 / core__0026 precedent). down() drops the unique index then the column (the link is re-minted idempotently on the next boot). SEQ IS PROVISIONAL: assigned at merge; renumber-at-merge is normal.
